ios.desc:
Traverse – Your Ultimate Travel Journal & Trip Tracker

Turn every journey into an epic story with Traverse, the free travel diary app built by travelers, for travelers. Whether you’re on a weekend getaway or a world‑spanning adventure, Traverse makes it effortless to capture memories, map your route, and share your favorite moments.

Why Travelers Love Traverse

Seamless Photo & Text Upload: Capture every sunrise, sunset, and serendipitous detour. Snap photos, add captions or journal entries, and organize them by date, location, or custom tags—all within a few taps.

Interactive World Map: Watch your travel map come alive as you pin every city, country, and hidden gem you explore. Zoom in to relive the streets of Paris or pan out to see your global adventures at a glance.

In‑Depth Travel Stats: Track miles traveled, countries visited, total days adventured, and more. Compare year‑over‑year progress in your personal wanderlust dashboard.

Social Feed & Community: Follow friends, family, and fellow explorers. Discover inspiring trips, comment on top moments, and build a community that fuels your travel passion.

Nostalgia Mode: Cure post‑travel blues by instantly diving back into curated highlights—photo collages, journal snippets, and map overviews of your best moments.

Customizable Trip Highlights: Create “Storyboards” for each trip—select your top 5 photos, key journal entries, and map snapshots to share with friends or save for yourself.

Offline Access: No signal? No problem. Plan your next move, jot down thoughts, and view past trips offline. All data syncs automatically when you’re back online.

Secure & Private: Your data belongs to you. Traverse offers optional passcodes and Touch/Face ID locks, plus flexible sharing settings so you control who sees your adventures.

Real‑Time Collaboration: Traveling with a friend? Invite them to co‑author a shared journal—both of you can upload photos and notes, creating a joint travel story in real time.

How Traverse Works

Create a New Trip: Tap “+ New Trip,” set your destination, dates, and personalized cover photo.

Capture Moments: Use in‑app camera or import from your gallery. Add text entries, tags, and locations.

Map & Track: Watch pins appear on your world map as you travel. Check live stats on distance, time zone changes, and country counts.

Share & Inspire: Publish trip highlights to your social feed or export as a beautiful PDF journal to share with friends and family.

Download Traverse Today an

Hey guys! I have been working on this app for about 2 months now and I have just launched it. It’s called Traverse and you can download it here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/traverse-connect-explore/id6569221684

Traverse is a social media app designed for travelers to connect with like-minded people, especially when exploring new places. It features an itinerary planner that helps you discover hidden gems, like hole-in-the-wall restaurants and must-see attractions recommended by fellow travelers. It’s also a great tool for keeping track of your trips, allowing you to store them in on place. Let mw know what you guys think and if you have any feedback that would be greatly appreciated
